$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFIP (AIP France, chart dated 2023-11-02): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Peyresourde-Balestas

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

reportingPoints.name: N2
reportingPoints.location: Bridge in the North of Loudenvielle lake

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
AD with special characteristics, reserved for rated ACFT pilots holding: a valid mountain qualification (wheels or/and skis), or a valid permission to access the altiport.
Microlight ACFT pilots: FFPLUM (FNVM) mountain formation strongly recommended.
AD usable by HEL without any restriction.
Non controlled AD: only one departure sector.
Routes and flight circuits on the chart.
Usable by aircraft with wheels: check engine ratings compatible with the data of the airfield (no snow sweeping).
AD prohibited to ACFT whithout A/A frequency.
AD unusable outside of the RWY and parking area.
Compulsory transmission of position reports on auto information frequency.
Very high snowdrifts may be located on the edges of the RWY and in the vicinity of the RWY 09 THR.
Heavy paragliding activity in the valley, 3 km West in RWY axis on eastem side of Azet pass and on Penaube crest Hazards of paragliders presence in Iow serial reconnaissance circuit after "S".
Landing is strongly not recommended by south wind conditions.
Altisurface PENE DE SOULIT 100° / 1.3 NM, ALT 6240 Arrival ARR from North: Arreau (N1) to the North of Génos Loudenvielle lake (N2) at 6000 ft, path west side of the valley.
ARR from East: Col de Peyresourde (E) to N2 at 5800 ft.
At N2 descend towards S point following the circuit depicted on the chart.
ARR from West: from power station (S) at 6000 ft.
At S point, turn descending heading 070° and integration following the circuit depicted on the chart.

Exit Follow the routes depicted on the chart and report position and intentions on A/A frequency overhead reporting points: North departure: follow "DEP N1" with path east side of the valley.; East departure: no right turn to E, follow "DEP E", continuous climb above the pattern and come back overhead altiport at 6300 ft to E.
Landing Landing RWY 09 mandatory.
Fly overhead threshold RWY 09 at upper platform height for altimeter setting (5200 ft) and check RWY condition and snow removal.
Pattern at 5300 ft.
Abort final approach for landing if an ACFT is on the RWY ready for departure or in movement on the upper platform without announcing it will delay his TKOF.
Take-off and departure Take-off RWY 27 mandatory.
Prior to line-up, observe final approach sector from the holding point for 30 seconds.
No ACFT will line up and take off if another ACFT has reported turning final.
After take-off, turn right to DEP N1 or DEP E or to join downwind leg (see chart).
Caution with traffic transiting via Peyresourde pass.
